name: Ichijou Souma
source: Main character of Vn. ran away from home 2 years ago when one day he was contacted by his sister about sick father. Was adopted after his parents died in accident as a young child. Is kind person that does try to act like an adult but will show his age at times as being a teenager. Is the youngest in family and very close to all his sisters.
